hero.subtitle: Meetor is Connect Skills' video room: join from your browser, talk to a specialist and leave with a clear review of how you did.

how.title: From booking to feedback, in four steps.
how.s1Text: The session is booked in Connect Skills' mentorship area, based on the specialist's availability.
how.s2Text: Each session has a unique link, and only authorized participants can join.
how.s3Text: The call runs in the browser, with nothing to install and a countdown of the time left.
how.s4Text: At the end, the specialist records the feedback and the candidate rates the session.

features.title: Built for sessions that lead somewhere.
features.desc: Everything a development conversation needs, with no extra tools.
features.f1Text: No download, no extension: open the link and the call starts.
features.f2Text: Before you join, Meetor checks that you're a participant in that session.
features.f3Text: A countdown shows how much time is left, and the link expires after the session.
features.f4Text: The specialist rates behavioral, technical and overall performance, from 0 to 100.
features.f5Text: Before it's sent, AI checks that the feedback is clear and useful for the candidate.
features.f6Text: If the candidate doesn't show up, the specialist marks it right in the room.
features.f7Text: The candidate rates the session from 1 to 5.
features.f8Text: Interface in Portuguese, English and Spanish, including inside the call.

audiences.title: Two sides, one conversation.
audiences.specialistDesc: Run sessions with everything at hand and leave feedback that actually helps.
audiences.specialist1: Private review panel during the call
audiences.specialist4: End the session and mark absences in the room
audiences.candidateDesc: Get ready for the job market by talking to people already in it.
audiences.candidate1: Join from the link, nothing to install

ecosystem.title: One account for everything.
ecosystem.desc: Meetor is part of Connect Skills. You use the same login on both platforms, and what happens in the room goes back to your dashboard.
ecosystem.i1Text: Sign in with your Connect Skills account or with Google, LinkedIn and Facebook.
ecosystem.i2Text: Sessions booked on Connect Skills come with the room link.
ecosystem.i3Text: Reviews are saved in the session report, inside Connect Skills.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.desc: Didn't find what you were looking for? Reach us through Connect Skills.
faq.q1: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a1: No. The call runs in the browser, on a computer or a phone.
faq.a2: Connect Skills users. If you don't have an account yet, just sign up there.
faq.q3: Can anyone with the link join?
faq.a3: No. Meetor checks that you're authorized to join that session before letting you in.
faq.q4: How long does a session last?
faq.a4: The length is set when booking. A countdown shows the time left, and the link expires when the session ends.
faq.a5: The specialist fills in three parts (behavioral, technical and overall) with scores from 0 to 100. AI reviews the text before it's sent, and the review is saved on Connect Skills.
faq.q6: Which languages is Meetor available in?

final.desc: Create a room now or join with the link you received.

footer.desc: Meetor is Connect Skills' video platform for sessions between candidates and specialists.
